name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme
benefit: Rs. 600 / - per month to the couple.
eligibility_rules: The native place should be Madhya PradeshThe benefits under this scheme can be availed to the couple having an only daughter as a child. The age of either of the beneficiary couples is 60 years or more. The beneficiary couple should not be income-tax payers. The children of the parent(beneficiary couple) should be daughters and should be married.
documents_required: List of required documents Certificate in respect of couple having an only girl child and no living son. Self
declaration certificate regarding not income taxpayer. Certificate regarding age and residence. Joint photo of the couple / one photo in case
of singles. Certificate of death of husband issued by the competent authority for the widow and abandoned women / attested copy of the
order issued by the Honorable Court for abandonment.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online & Offline Application processApply with the prescribed application form in the Gram Panchayat / District Panchayat in the rural area of your original residence, And In the office of the Municipal Corporation / Municipality / Municipal Council in the urban area.
